message.content:
Painting the Eiffel Tower is a massive undertaking that typically takes **about 15 months** (roughly one year and five months) to complete. Here’s why:

| Factor | Typical Value |
|--------|---------------|
| **Paint required** | ~60 tons of paint (to cover all exposed metal surfaces) |
| **Coats applied** | Usually 2–3 coats of protective paint |
| **Crew size** | ~200 workers (including painters, riggers, safety personnel, and support staff) |
| **Work schedule** | Continuous work (often 24/7) during the 15‑month period |
| **Frequency** | The tower is repainted roughly every 7 years to protect against corrosion |

So if you’re wondering how long it would take to paint the Eiffel Tower from start to finish, expect a project that spans over a year—typically around 15 months of intensive, round‑the‑clock effort.
